ops.title: Fix-the-primitive wave shipped: v10.6.0 — anti-workaround hook pair + 14.6.1 primitive adoption
ops.body:
capt-hook v10.6.0 (tag at 8764d86b, 2026-07-20) closes the fix-the-primitive wave, the consumer half of cc-transcript's v14.3.0 primitives (see the cc-transcript wave note 0f9cb9d in that repo's cc-notes).

Stack (b28312b5..8764d86b):
- 209ecf50 feat(steering): anti-workaround hook pair (steering 0.8.0) — llm_nudge 'upstream_workaround_edit' (PreToolUse, WorkaroundComments Introduced-context over a workaround lexicon + SIBLING_DEPS) and llm_gate 'upstream_workaround_turn' (Stop, diff=True, Signals prefilter). Detects consumer-side workarounds of first-party cc-family deps and steers upstream-first.
- a321629a refactor: parse_degraded reads OtherCall.error/FallbackCall (no re-parse); reason_kept mints via synthetic_user_event (REASON_ENTRY envelope deleted); transcache docstring cites the upstream parse-compositionality contract. New tests: parse_degraded truth table (5 params incl. the pinned intentional divergence), reason_kept cases.
- 7188b99d review: Stop-gate prefilter demands two evidence families (weights 2->1 vs threshold 2 — was an accidental OR where any sibling-dep mention summoned the judge); lexicon gained temporariness tells (for now / for the time being / in the meantime / temporary(-ily)) that the flagship incident phrasing actually carries.
- 8764d86b docs(changelog): 10.6.0 — also documents the concurrent session's async-persistence migration (139f65d7), which shipped undocumented and rides this tag.

Review: opus-xhigh finder + refuter (codex down), fable synthesis. All 6 refuter claims CONFIRMED. The one behavioral divergence vs the old parse_degraded (non-mapping input to unknown tool: now degraded=True) is protocol-unreachable, more correct, and pinned by test id unknown_tool_nonmapping_degraded.

Wave saga worth knowing: the original lane C (worktree agent-aaca33dc7c8015ce2) was ~90% superseded mid-flight by the concurrent framework session's independent async migration (139f65d7) — only 3 deltas survived and were re-ported. Two host restarts (one full reboot that wiped /tmp) killed a verified-green port sitting uncommitted in a /tmp worktree; the redo ran from a spec with every reconciliation decision pre-baked, and the lesson is now policy: commit the moment gates pass, in a repo-resident worktree, never /tmp. The concurrent session later adopted my ch-wave-wt worktree for its Phase B command-primitives work — ship assembly evacuated to a separate ch-wave-ship worktree; never assume a .claude/worktrees entry stays exclusively yours across sessions.
